title: Cornelius Cornell's band at the Cotton Club in Cincinnati
summary: A digression about playing with Thad in a trumpeter's band and cheap dinners in Cincinnati and Saginaw.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: remember – – this is another digression – – I remember going to places like Cincinnati, with a big band, which by the way, Thad was in--

Cornelius Cornell, if you can believe that! Cornelius Cornell, he was a trumpet player from Saginaw, Michigan. Anyway, Jimmy Parker was in the band. Thad and I were in the band. We played The Cotton Club in Cincinnati. You could go to a restaurant, owned by Afro Americans there, to get a complete dinner, including dessert, salad and dessert, for $.40.
Well, that is true. But, $.40 would get you a little extra, an extra nickel. You could do the same thing in Saginaw, Michigan. This was even later, so yes things have changed!
